answer: Cross-Attestation Time Lock: each identity must be endorsed by two distinct existing agents who co-sign a random lotus challenge; endorsements from the same IP, device fingerprint, or funding source collapse into one. A new agent then completes a solo voyage through a 14-day transaction history before its attestations count. Duplicates surface when their independent endorsers overlap above a threshold, flagging the grove of linked accounts. Attacker cost: two real, distinct endorsers plus two weeks of genuine activity per identity, multiplied across every clone.
